name: ConvertTextToNumberNode
label: Convert Text to Number
description: Converts a text representation of a number to a numeric value.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: TextToConvert
fields.label: Text to Convert
fields.description: The text value that will be converted to a numeric type.

fields.name: OutputType
fields.label: Output Type
fields.description: Specifies the numeric type to which the text should be converted.

selectOptions.label: Whole number
selectOptions.description: Whole numbers with no decimals, e.g. 123.

selectOptions.label: Decimal number
selectOptions.description: Numbers with decimals for general use, e.g. 123.45 (accurate to about 15-17 significant digits).

selectOptions.label: Exact decimal number
selectOptions.description: Numbers with decimals kept exactly up to 28-29 significant digits, e.g. 19.99 for money.

fields.name: ConvertedValue
fields.label: Converted Value
fields.description: Returns the resulting numeric value after conversion.
